clauses.label: A
clauses.title: Scope of Services
clauses.text: Blue Ridge Industries shall provide the services described in Exhibit A (the "Services") to Northwind Technologies in a professional and workmanlike manner, consistent with industry standards. Any changes to the scope of the Services must be agreed in writing by both parties before work begins.

clauses.label: B
clauses.title: Governing Law
clauses.text: This Agreement shall be governed by and construed in accordance with the laws of the State of Delaware, without regard to its conflict of laws principles. The parties consent to the exclusive jurisdiction of the state and federal courts located in Delaware.

clauses.label: C
clauses.title: Entire Agreement
clauses.text: This Agreement, together with its exhibits, constitutes the entire agreement between Northwind Technologies and Blue Ridge Industries with respect to its subject matter and supersedes all prior or contemporaneous understandings. Any amendment must be in writing and signed by both parties.

clauses.label: D
clauses.title: Independent Contractor
clauses.text: Blue Ridge Industries is an independent contractor and nothing in this Agreement creates a partnership, joint venture, agency, or employment relationship between the parties. Blue Ridge Industries is solely responsible for its own taxes, insurance, and employee obligations.

clauses.label: E
clauses.title: Term and Renewal
clauses.text: This Agreement shall commence on the Effective Date and continue for an initial term of 24 months, unless earlier terminated as provided herein. The Agreement will renew automatically for successive terms of equal length unless either party gives written notice of non-renewal at least 30 days before the end of the then-current term.

clauses.label: F
clauses.title: Compensation
clauses.text: In consideration of the Services, Northwind Technologies shall pay Blue Ridge Industries fees not to exceed $207,000 per invoice period. All invoices are payable within 30 days of receipt. Amounts unpaid after the due date accrue interest at the lesser of 1.5% per month or the maximum rate permitted by law.

clauses.label: G
clauses.title: Confidentiality
clauses.text: Each party agrees to hold in strict confidence all non-public information disclosed by the other party in connection with this Agreement, and to use such information solely to perform its obligations hereunder. This obligation survives termination of this Agreement for a period of 24 months.
